name: Madataki
source:
Celeste looks at the peaceful sky. Someday, he will travel to the wide world. But for now the ordinary life is good and full of fascinating encounters. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塞莱斯望着宁静的天空。总有一天，他要踏上广阔世界的旅程。但现在，平凡的生活也很好，并且充满迷人的邂逅。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
